description: Alibaba Cloud Security Center (SAS) Overview Data Query Skill. Retrieves security score, asset status, risk governance, asset risk trends, and billing info. Supports flexible scope: query a single data item, a specific module, or the full overview based on user intent. 阿里云云安全中心（SAS）总览数据查询技能。 可获取安全评分、资产状态、风险治理、资产风险趋势及账单信息。 支持灵活查询范围：根据用户意图查询单个数据项、特定模块或完整总览。 Triggers: "SAS overview", "security center overview", "SAS 总览", "云安全中心总览", "security score", "安全评分", "安全分", "fixed vulnerability statistics", "baseline risk", "handled alerts", "已修复漏洞统计", "基线风险统计", "已处理告警", "host assets", "uninstalled clients", "主机资产", "CPU 核数", "未安装客户端", "risk governance", "WAF blocks", "asset risk trend", "风险治理", "WAF 拦截统计", "资产风险趋势", "SAS billing", "订阅状态", "云安全中心账单", "按量模块开关" Out of scope: This Skill only covers SAS overview data queries. It does not perform remediation, modify configurations, or manage non-SAS services.
